title: Hangover
text: Before long…
“Woof! A draw, Shion!”
“I know that, *hic*!”
Crocodile Guy drank, glug glug.
“Here, Motoyasu-sama!”
“Whoaaaa! Indeed!”
Encouraged by Yuki-chan, I downed my own cup dry as well.
“Heh… How about that!”
“I did it, indeed.”
Urrgh… my eyes were spinning round and round, indeed…
“Woof-hoo! Next ma— match…”
Wolf, thoroughly drunk with his tongue tripping over itself, drained his cup and pressed on to the next round, but Crocodile Guy showed no sign of moving at all, still standing right where he was.
“Woof?”
Wolf waved a hand back and forth in front of Crocodile Guy’s face, but he didn’t so much as twitch. He’d frozen solid, mug still in hand.
“Woof! Vict’ry!”
Wolf let out a victory howl. He was trying to say “victory” but couldn’t quite get it out. No doubt about it — he was on the verge of collapsing drunk himself.
“A-and all that’s left… *hic*… is the… S-Spear Hero…”

Wolf swayed as he turned his gaze toward me, but my own vision was spinning in circles, and I’d rolled right over, unable to get up. Guh… I meant to keep a clear head, but everything just kept spinning, indeed. I understood the situation perfectly well — or so I thought… ugh.
“Uh, uhhhh”
“Woof.”
Wolf was about to declare his victory outright, but— n-not yet, I hadn’t lost yet, indeed. I couldn’t afford to lose here. Wolf turned his gaze toward me as I writhed on the floor.
“I can… still keep g-goin’, I shay.”
“Woof-heh-heh. If y’can take this and still be fine, then we keep goin’.”
His slurring was ridiculous! Don’t go gloating like that, indeed. Guh… I ought to summon my spear and unleash Brionac— no, I needed to hurry and take some hangover medicine instead.
“By the command of the Claw Hero, wellspring of power. Decipher the myriad creation once more, and transform this one’s form.”
“Fairy… urrp… Morph.”
With a poof, Wolf hit me with Fairy Morph. I tumbled right over and turned into a usaunny.
“Uuuugh…”
Guh… I’d had no room to counter. No, I should have been able to, but drunk as I was, my head wouldn’t work properly and I had no strength left in me.
“Motoyasu-sama…”
Yuki-chan watched with worry as I crawled out from my fallen clothes.
“Woof-hoo! C’mon now, change back already.”
“Gnnnh… I shay sooo…”
I tried desperately to stand, but I had no strength in my hips. Just as I struggled to rise, Wolf grabbed me by the scruff of the neck.
“W-what’re you doin’, I shay…”
“Motoyasu-sama!?”
“Woof.”
Then, quite unhurried, Wolf handed me over to Yuki-chan.
“My win! Take him home, do what you like.”
He even gave a thumbs-up and, for some reason, pushed Yuki-chan on the back.
“…Motoyasu-sama, I’m afraid it seems tonight’s match ends in a loss.”
“Uuuugh…”

Not yet, indeed. Yuki-chan! I couldn’t give up here. I could still go on! So please, let me stand. I tried to say as much, opening my mouth, but no voice came out at all, and my head kept spinning. Guuuh… Paaandaaaaaaaa!
“Zzz…”

And there was Panda, not the least bit drunk, resting Father on her lap and frozen mid-gesture of gently stroking him, sound asleep. Curse youuuu! You had the power to win this whole contest outright, so why were you being so leisurely about it?
“Come, Motoyasu-sama. Tonight, we retreat.”
Yuki-chan rose to her feet and, cradling me just as I was, made to carry me out of the room.
“Uuuugh… n-noo… I shay… indeeed.”
No, I didn’t want this, I didn’t want this at all. Yuki-chan, where are you taking meeee!
“Woof-hoo!”

Wolf scooped up the already-sleeping Father, carried him off to bed, and once he’d laid him down, thrust a triumphant fist into the air. And then, carried off in Yuki-chan’s arms, Father and the rest faded from view. Ugh… the feeling of Father being stolen away by a rival flashed through my mind, and at that very instant, my consciousness snapped and drifted far away.
“Huh!?”

The next time I came to, I was in Yuki-chan’s bed, still in usaunny form, wrapped up snugly in her feathers. I sat up, wriggled my way free of her plumage, and peered outside to find the sun already climbing quite high in the sky — and at the same time, my head was pounding with a ferocious, splitting ache…
“Motoyasu-sama! Good morning!”
Sparkling with energy, Yuki-chan greeted me cheerfully the moment she noticed I was awake.
“Good morning, indeed.”

Ugh, my head hurt… Brewing hangover medicine was quite the ordeal. A hangover was the sort of thing that wouldn’t heal easily even with recovery magic. It even had a serious effect on spell incantations. But I couldn’t back down here. I hurried to change back into my original form and made my way through Wolf’s castle to rush to Father’s side. And then…
“Oh, morning, Motoyasu-kun. You’re pretty late. Want something to eat?”
I ran into Father in the lower hall, spreading out some sort of map and talking things over with Panda, Rabbit Guy, Crocodile Guy, Elephant, and Wolf.
“Guh…”
“Uhhhhh…”
“Woofff…”
“You all drank way too much, Motoyasu-kun included.”
Father scolded us, exasperated, as we suffered through our hangovers.
“I have no idea what you all were even competing over, but…”
Elephant said, sounding thoroughly exasperated. He already had Kou at his side, incidentally. I vaguely recalled some voice that morning, something about Kou coming to find him.
“F-Father. Did… nothing happen?”
“Nothing? What do you mean?”

Father asked, looking as if he genuinely had no clue what I was getting at. I needed to press Wolf about exactly what had happened after that. When I turned my gaze toward him, Wolf himself wore an extremely frustrated expression. Oh? Could it be that Panda had blocked him?
“I worked so hard to win, and yet nothing…”
Wolf muttered under his breath, his face pale.

“Ah, right, Wolf had his fist thrust up in the air and was lying down by my feet for some reason. Shion stayed standing the whole time, and Teo was lying down too. Seems like everyone passed out in some pretty distinctive sleeping poses.”
“I-Is that so.”
“And Lars-chan was sleeping right next to me? I feel like she was looking this way, and since she was cute, I think I just grabbed her hand and went back to sleep.”
“Panda?”

“Hah? Don’t call me cute. I woke up to go to the bathroom, and when I got back, everyone was asleep exactly like he said. So I looked at his sleeping face and figured I’d head back to my own room, but he grabbed my hand and wouldn’t let go, so I had no choice but to just sleep there beside him. Yaaawn…”

So apparently, after taking a good look at Father’s sleeping face, Father had half-asleep gone and grabbed hold of Panda’s hand. Unable to pry it free afterward, Panda had ended up sleeping right there beside him. That was hardly the yawn of someone who hadn’t slept a wink! Panda! When I pressed further, Wolf confessed he’d been rolling around at Father’s feet the whole time and never woke up. He also admitted that Father, half-asleep, had clung onto him and left him unable to move — used as a body pillow, apparently. He didn’t look entirely displeased about it, either. Seemed he’d proven more useful than I expected. Push harder, indeed.
“And Motoyasu-kun, you went home with Yuki-chan, right?”
“I-Indeed!”

I affirmed it before Yuki-chan could even answer. There was simply no way I could admit that, of all things, Wolf had turned me into a usaunny and carried me off in a drunken stupor while I lay there helpless.
“Competing over who can hold their liquor better is all well and good, but if you all end up like this the next day, you ought to take it a little easier.”
Father, understanding absolutely nothing, lectured us.
“…Yes, quite right. Wolf.”
“Ah, well, seems he at least managed to sleep in a bathrobe.”
“Vuuuh… not yet, not yet.”
“You really don’t know when to give up, do you… ugh…”
All we could do in response was nod along in silence.
“Well, it’s good that you all managed to build such a lively friendship out of it, I suppose. Seems like I just don’t get drunk at all, huh.”
Father remarked, sounding a touch left out — a rather memorable moment, that. Incidentally… Yuki-chan seemed to be in an unusually good mood for some reason.
And so, after spending several days like that at Wolf’s family home, it seemed some sort of request had come in for Wolf.
